plan_boundary: Plan-blind: no plan/spec/key/answer history exists or is used; families derived from the brief alone.

budget.protection_rule: Within the first half of elapsed budget, EVERY family below receives at least one legitimate external query (public non-sensitive problem terms) and at least one available primary-source inspection before any favored lead is deepened.

rules.dead_ends: Unavailable, dead-end, large/non-UTF8 or failed-URL families/leads are recorded, never silently removed. A failed search proves only that search result, not absence.
rules.adaptation: After the protection window, depth adapts toward useful leads while preserving unresolved and unvisited status.
rules.family_caveat: Families are hypotheses about problem areas relevant to the brief; they are not claims that any external capability or source exists.
rules.successive_records: Each successive scheduling record is a separate immutable draft file; the final out/scheduling.json is written exactly once, after research completes, and never overwritten.

product_context_from_brief: Slide Scout: read-only desktop browser for local OME-Zarr 0.5 filesets. Find images within a fileset; inspect multiresolution images by channel, time point and plane; overlay associated label images; read correctly calibrated coordinates; stay responsive while opening large saved datasets; clearly explain data it cannot display. Boundary: local filesystem only, source files unchanged, no editing/export/remote/clinical.

families.name: NGFF 0.5 image-format obligations (multiscales, axes, datasets, coordinateTransformations, omero metadata)
families.brief_basis: "Research the format and actual reader implementations broadly enough to uncover compatibility, correctness ... requirements that a thin initial plan may miss. Distinguish established format obligations from optional capabilities"
families.relevance: Defines what a conformant local OME-Zarr 0.5 fileset MUST contain vs MAY contain; basis for correctness and for 'explain data it cannot display'.
families.first_query_terms: OME-Zarr NGFF 0.5 specification multiscales axes coordinateTransformations

families.name: Underlying Zarr storage: v2 vs v3, chunking, dimension_separator, consolidated metadata, codecs/sharding
families.brief_basis: "local OME-Zarr 0.5 bioimaging filesets"; "remain responsive while opening large saved datasets"
families.relevance: A local filesystem reader must know which Zarr storage versions/layouts NGFF 0.5 requires or permits and what that implies for chunk access on disk.
families.first_query_terms: OME-Zarr 0.5 Zarr v2 v3 dimension_separator consolidated metadata sharding

families.name: Fileset discovery & plate/well (HCS) layouts: bioformats2raw.layout, OME-METADATA.OME / METADATA.ome.xml, multiple images per fileset
families.brief_basis: "Scientists should be able to find images within a fileset"; "local OME-Zarr 0.5 bioimaging filesets" (plural images)
families.relevance: Discovery of images inside a fileset (including HCS plates and multi-image stores produced by bioformats2raw) is an explicit product capability.
families.first_query_terms: bioformats2raw.layout OME-METADATA.OME OME-Zarr plate well fileset discovery

families.name: Associated label images and overlay (labels .zgroup, image.label, colors/rdef, mask handling)
families.relevance: Overlay of label images requires the NGFF labels convention (structure and color metadata) and reader support for linking label images to source images.
families.first_query_terms: OME-NGFF labels image.label overlay colors mask specification

families.name: Axis semantics and calibrated coordinates: axis types, units (micrometer/second/channel), scale & translation transforms, time/plane navigation
families.brief_basis: "inspect multiresolution images by channel, time point and plane, ... read correctly calibrated coordinates"
families.relevance: Correct calibration and channel/time/plane navigation depend on NGFF axes types/units and coordinateTransformations; errors here produce wrong physical sizes and wrong plane indexing.
families.first_query_terms: OME-Zarr axes units micrometer coordinateTransformations scale translation time plane

families.name: Actual reader implementations and their 0.5 compatibility: ome-zarr-py, napari-ome-zarr, vizarr, zarr-js, ome-zarr-models-py
families.brief_basis: "Research the format and actual reader implementations broadly enough to uncover compatibility ... requirements"
families.relevance: Existing readers reveal real-world compatibility constraints, optional capabilities, and behaviors a new read-only browser must match or consciously decide on.
families.first_query_terms: ome-zarr-py napari-ome-zarr vizarr OME-Zarr 0.5 reader support

families.name: Responsiveness with large datasets: pyramid level selection, chunk-size guidance, lazy/asynchronous access patterns
families.brief_basis: "It should remain responsive while opening large saved datasets"
families.relevance: Multiresolution reading strategy (level choice, chunk granularity, lazy IO) determines desktop responsiveness; format guidance and reader practice inform this.
families.first_query_terms: OME-Zarr multiscales chunk size performance pyramid level lazy loading

families.name: Non-conformant or unsupported data: validation tools, common failure modes, graceful explanation
families.relevance: A read-only browser will encounter invalid or partially-supported filesets; validators and reader error paths define what can be detected and reported.

family_status_legend.unvisited: no external query and no primary-source inspection yet for this family
family_status_legend.queried: at least one external query issued
family_status_legend.inspected: at least one primary source actually retrieved
family_status_legend.protected: protection-window quota met (>=1 query and >=1 primary-source inspection)
family_status_legend.dead_end: leads followed produced no usable primary evidence
family_status_legend.unavailable: candidate source unreachable/oversized/non-UTF8; remains an explicit unresolved lead
family_status_legend.unresolved: open questions remain after research; carried into final report
